what: a circle of radius 5 swept 20 mm up a straight path between two guide rails from (5,0,0) to (10,0,20) and from (-5,0,0) to (-10,0,20)
method: the profile follows the rails (its points where they start stay on both) and is sized by their distance, 10 at the start and 20 at the end: the same cone frustum, V = 20/3 pi (25 + 100 + 50) = 3665.2.
